28. Partial Staging and Amend

SIMPLE ENGLISH
git add -p stages selected hunks. commit --amend replaces the tip commit, so avoid amending
published shared history without coordination.
සිංහJලෙන් File එකක changes කිහිපයකේ තිJයන විට add -p මඟින් Jකාටස් Jතහෝරා stage කරන්න පුළුවන්.

git add -p src/app.js
git diff --staged
git commit -m "Fix calculation"
# Local unpublished tip only:
git commit --amend -m "Fix tax calculation"
Expected: Only selected hunks enter the commit; amend changes its ID.
Does amend edit the original commit in place? No, it creates a replacement commit.
